title: Control plane

scope.label: Live observation scope
scope.sample: Synthetic sample stream - not operational evidence
scope.notReady: No authoritative runtime source observed - not valid as live readiness evidence

lead: See what needs attention now, follow each control-loop stage, and open recorded evidence. This surface observes; it never executes.

health.label: Live observation health
health.dropped: {count} old frame(s) dropped at the bounded buffer

observations.title: Source reads
observations.note: Newest bounded read-only evidence - not complete history, a control-loop decision, or execution.
observations.waiting: Observation stream connected. Waiting for the next source-read activity.
observations.empty: No source-read activity has been recorded yet.

detail.readOnly: This panel presents bounded source-read evidence only. It is not a control-loop decision or execution result.

coverage.title: What is inventoried, evaluated, and detected
coverage.boundary: Catalog inventory, Azure Resource Graph coverage, analyzer checks, and rule findings are separate evidence sets. A catalog count never implies that every rule was evaluated.
coverage.findingHint: {published} published into the control loop - {errors} errors
coverage.ruleEvaluationMissing: No authoritative rule-findings summary is published.
coverage.analyzerUnrecorded: No complete analyzer tick receipt has been retained.

attention.label: Attention
attention.deniedTitle: The risk gate refused these actions. Inspect the policy evidence.
attention.failedTitle: A control-loop stage failed. Inspect the recorded audit entry.
attention.stuckTitle: These items exceeded the latency budget published by the control plane.
attention.none: No control-loop work currently needs attention.
attention.unavailable: Live attention is unavailable. Recorded outcomes remain in History.

work.title: Control-loop work
work.filterNote: Select an item to inspect its stage trace.
work.noMatch: No control-loop work matches this filter.

tier.t0: T0 uses deterministic rules for repeatable decisions.
tier.t1: T1 reuses evidence-backed similarity from prior validated patterns.
tier.t2: T2 uses grounded adaptive reasoning and still requires deterministic verification.
tier.unknown: The decision tier has not been observed.

autonomy.A0: A0 observes, explains, or simulates only; it cannot mutate a managed target.
autonomy.A1: A1 permits a reversible, resource-scoped low-risk action inside current policy.
autonomy.A2: A2 permits a promoted workflow inside a measured and pre-approved envelope.
autonomy.A3_H: A3-H requires independent per-execution human approval before dispatch.
autonomy.A3_E: A3-E uses valid standing human authorization for a bounded reversible emergency mitigation.
autonomy.A4: A4 is denied; execution is prohibited.
autonomy.guide: Authority guide: A0 observes; A1 is bounded low risk; A2 is a promoted envelope; A3-H requires current approval; A3-E requires standing authorization; A4 is denied. This event has not published an exact autonomy class.

mode.pending: Pending means policy and execution mode have not been observed.
mode.shadow: Shadow mode evaluates and records without changing the target.
mode.enforce: Enforce mode can dispatch only after policy, safety, and authority checks; dispatch does not prove effect success.
mode.gated: Gated means the current decision path blocks dispatch until its required review or approval is satisfied.

empty.connected: Authoritative runtime source observed. There is no current control-loop work.
empty.awaitingSource: The SSE connection is open, but no authoritative runtime source has been observed. Check Core Runtime and stage-topic readiness.
empty.connecting: Connecting to the live event stream.
empty.idle: Live observation is idle while this view is not connected.
empty.unavailable: Live observation is unavailable. Use History for recorded outcomes.

selectionWaiting: Waiting for event {event} to appear in the live stream.
selectionUnavailable: Event {event} is not available in the current bounded live window.

outcomes.title: Recent outcomes
outcomes.viewAll: View all recorded outcomes in History

detail.readOnly: This panel is read-only. Approvals happen in ChatOps or via a remediation PR.
